title: "Species ID guide"

Use this page to identify the species that you sample. Note that all images are copyrighted. We have provided the source of each image so that you can find more information about the species, and to give credit to the original authors.

Note: images are only available in the HTML version of this document.

::: {.content-visible unless-format="pdf"}
